Infected lesions are more common in familial cases.

nodes.description: Familial SM is caused by heterozygous KRT17 missense variants, most at the start of the 1A helix of the rod domain (p.Asn92His, p.Arg94His, p.Arg94Cys, p.Arg94Gly) and a few in the head domain (p.Ser24Leu, p.Gly34Ser). The helix initiation motif is the assembly-critical region in which pachyonychia congenita keratin variants act dominant-negatively; the identical p.Arg94Cys and p.Asn92Ser changes are reported in both SM and PC-K17 families, so genotype alone does not predict which phenotype results.
